steps.text: Push a wooden dowel into one of the two holes on top of each leg.
Set the shelf on the legs and fix each leg with a long screw and the Allen key.
Lay the top face down on a soft surface and screw the four cam bolts into it.
Lower the two side panels onto the cam bolts at each end.
Push a cam lock into each round hole and turn it with a flat screwdriver to lock the sides.
Screw an angle bracket to the top at the back edge, next to each side, with two screws each.
Turn the shelf and legs over onto the sides and fix them with four long screws.
Stand the bench upright against the wall and mark through both bracket holes with a pencil.
Move the bench away and drive a round-head screw into each mark, leaving the head out.
Push the bench back, hang a keyhole plate on each screw, tighten it and slide on the cover.
